declarations: 1.  That we are the co owners or lessors entitled to issue rent directions concerning the Lease Deed identified in Schedule A. Ownership shares and agreed rent entitlements are separately recorded in Schedule B. Equal ownership is not presumed from four recorded names.

2.  That we approve the completed Schedules voluntarily, understanding their consequences and without coercion, misrepresentation or undue influence. All material entries shall be completed and unused alternatives struck out before affirmation. These joint directions shall be implemented only after all four Owners have personally signed and affirmed the completed affidavit and the Lessee has received all notarial endorsements.

3.  That Schedule B records rent entitlement and Schedule C records bank credit percentages. A zero bank credit percentage does not extinguish rent entitlement. Any agreed zero rent entitlement must be expressly entered under Mode B and supported by clause 10.

4.  That we direct the Lessee to pay by bank transfer to the Owners identified in Schedule C in the stated percentages. The nominated recipient need not hold the Power of Attorney. Appointment as attorney does not confer entitlement to another Owner's rent.

5.  That under Mode A the nominated recipient shall hold and account for each other Owner's share on that Owner's behalf. Under Mode B the entitlement shall be as expressly entered in Schedule B and lawfully implemented under the identified operative instrument.

6.  That these directions cover advance, annual, escalated and proportionate lease rent for the stated period, subject to the Lease Deed. Security deposits, compensation, sale or acquisition proceeds and unrelated payments are excluded. Earlier rent or arrears are included only as specified here: ________________________________.

7.  That payment actually and validly credited in accordance with Schedule C, together with tax lawfully deducted and remitted, shall discharge the corresponding rent obligation only to that amount and period. No duplicate payment shall be demanded. Unpaid rent, failed or unauthorised payments, and lawful claims against a nominated recipient remain unaffected.

8.  That deductions, tax reporting and certificates shall comply with applicable law. Payment into one account does not itself determine or transfer tax liability. We shall furnish the correct PAN particulars and legally required declarations and records.

9.  That these directions operate only for the stated period and while lawful. Changes require written approval by the persons whose rights are affected and delivery to the Lessee. Notice of death, incapacity, succession or an order affecting entitlement requires supporting evidence and fresh lawful directions for the affected share. An attorney cannot change this arrangement merely by virtue of that appointment.

10.  That a Mode B allocation differing from existing legal entitlements takes effect only under the Lease Deed or another legally effective instrument identified in Schedule A. This affidavit and notarisation do not themselves transfer or release ownership or any right requiring a further duly stamped or registered instrument.

11.  That this affidavit concerns only rent allocation and payment consent. It grants no authority to dispose of or encumber land, operate another Owner's bank account or sign on another's behalf. It does not enlarge any Power of Attorney.

12.  That we request the Lessee to acknowledge and implement these directions consistently with the Lease Deed and law. Any necessary amendment or incorporation in an executed lease shall be completed in the legally required form; this affidavit does not unilaterally amend that lease.
affidavit.verification: We, the above named deponents, each verify that the statements in this affidavit and the completed Schedules A, B and C are true and correct to our respective personal knowledge and, as to the title, lease and banking particulars, to the records examined and believed to be true. Our consent and payment directions are voluntary. Nothing material to this declaration has been concealed. All material blanks have been completed, unused entries struck out and corrections initialled before affirmation.
affidavit.modeA: Mode A  Existing entitlement retained. Each Owner retains the lawful rent entitlement stated below. Any single account arrangement is for collection on behalf of the Owners and does not give the account holder the others' shares.
affidavit.modeB: Mode B  Express allocation approved. Each Owner consents to the rent entitlement stated below for the period in Schedule A, including 100% to one Owner and 0% to the others if so entered, subject to clause 10. Ownership of the land is not relinquished.
affidavit.acknowledgment: Acknowledged and accepted for payment administration in accordance with the identified Lease Deed and applicable law. This acknowledgment does not independently amend an executed lease or determine ownership, tax liability or rights requiring a separate legal instrument.

leasePowers: 4.1  To sign, execute and deliver, separately for and on behalf of each Principal as lessor, the single lease deed identified as Annexure B1, hereinafter referred to as the Lease Deed, strictly in favour of the lessee and upon the terms, consideration, period and payment particulars approved in Schedule B. Where the Attorney also holds an interest in the Scheduled Land, the Attorney shall execute separately in his or her personal capacity for that interest. This authority shall not extend to any other version, amendment, supplemental deed, rectification, renewal or extension.

4.2  To present the Lease Deed for registration, appear before the competent registering officer, admit its execution on behalf of each Principal, identify the capacity in which the Attorney acts, and sign the presentation forms, statements and endorsements relating solely to that registration. For that purpose, the Attorney may produce the duly registered and authenticated original of this Deed or an accepted certified copy, supply the Attorney's own photograph, signature and biometric particulars, lodge proof of stamp duty and fees paid directly by the party liable therefor, and obtain official receipts and registered copies. No authority is conferred to use or substitute a Principal's personal signature or biometric.

4.3  The contemplated place of registration is the office of the Sub Registrar at Naliya, District Kutch, Gujarat, subject to that office possessing territorial jurisdiction over the Scheduled Land. The Attorney shall not present the Lease Deed until all permissions or lawful exemptions required before execution or registration have been verified and obtained, as applicable. Nothing contained herein shall dispense with any restriction imposed by the applicable tenancy, tenure, ceiling, revenue or registration law.

4.4  Where expressly provided in the approved Lease Deed, to execute the possession memorandum forming part of Annexure B1 and deliver possession of the approved leased area to the named lessee solely in its capacity as lessee, in accordance with the Lease Deed and applicable law. This power shall not extend to possession for any independent transaction, to any additional land or to any conveyance of ownership.
naPowers: 5.1  To sign and submit only the applications, landowner consents, no objection certificates, factual declarations and limited undertakings specifically identified and attached in Schedule C, for non agricultural use of the Scheduled Land solely for the solar project approved in Schedule B. The applicable statutory procedure shall be that lawfully available under section 65 or, where its conditions are fulfilled, section 65B of the Gujarat Land Revenue Code, 1879, read with the applicable Government resolutions. This Deed shall not be construed as establishing eligibility under either provision.

5.2  In connection with the documents so identified, to attend before the competent revenue authority, submit supporting copies and factual replies consistent with the approved documents, lodge official challans paid directly by the person liable, and receive acknowledgments, deficiency notices and the resulting order or certificate. The Attorney shall promptly furnish copies thereof to every Principal. No general authority to represent the Principals before other departments or in unrelated proceedings is conferred.
limits: 6.1  The Attorney shall have no authority to sell, agree to sell, gift, exchange, release, relinquish, partition, settle or convey ownership of the Scheduled Land or any interest therein; to grant an option to purchase or a right of first refusal concerning ownership; or to consent to acquisition, surrender of title or settlement of compensation.

6.2  The Attorney shall have no authority to mortgage, charge or encumber the land, deposit title deeds, borrow money, execute a guarantee or surety, or consent to lender security, substitution or step in rights, whether concerning the Principals' title or the lessee's leasehold interest. In particular, the Attorney shall not accept any stipulation creating a charge over the land for repayment of advance rent or any other obligation.

6.3  The Attorney shall have no authority to grant another lease, sublease, licence, development agreement, joint venture, assignment consent or independent easement or right of way. Access within the Scheduled Land may be provided only to the extent expressly shown in Annexure B1. No right in any other land shall be granted.

6.4  The Attorney shall not negotiate or vary the approved lessee, land, term, rent, escalation, deposit, advance adjustment, tax allocation or other terms; agree to automatic renewal or a future lease; or execute any subsequent renewal, extension, surrender, cancellation, termination, amendment or rectification. Any authority for such act shall require a separate instrument executed with the formalities prescribed by law.

6.5  Money and bank accounts. No collection, receipt, endorsement, withdrawal, appropriation, settlement, refund or discharge of rent, advance rent, deposit, compensation or any other money for a Principal. No opening or operation of a bank account and no change of payee, bank account, allocation or payment mandate. Payments must go directly to the entitled owners under their personally signed instructions. The Attorney's own entitlement, if any, is separate from this appointment.

6.6  No false payment acknowledgment. No signing a statement that payment has been received by a Principal unless that Principal has personally confirmed the specific amount and transaction in writing and the banking record supports it. Any acknowledgment in the approved lease is limited to that verified direct payment and is not a general receipt or discharge.

6.7  The Attorney shall not delegate any power, appoint a substitute attorney or sub agent, or grant a further power of attorney to the lessee, developer, lender, broker or any other person. A clerk engaged solely to carry documents shall have no authority to sign, admit execution or exercise discretion.

6.8  The Attorney shall not institute, defend, withdraw, compromise or settle any suit, criminal proceeding, revenue appeal or revision, arbitration or contested proceeding; consent to a decree; appoint an advocate; or execute a vakalatnama. Attendance for administrative scrutiny under Schedule C shall not authorise conduct of any contested proceeding.

6.9  The Attorney shall not procure deletion or substitution of an owner, determine shares, effect partition or succession mutation, alter a boundary, undertake re survey or change tenure. A filing solely to record the registered lease in the appropriate other rights entry or to record the approved NA use may be signed only where its exact form is separately identified and attached in Schedule C. No alteration of ownership rights is authorised thereby.

6.10  The Attorney shall have no authority to manage or cultivate the property, collect produce, employ contractors, sell resources, obtain utility connections, enter into construction contracts, or obtain project licences or clearances outside the specified NA file. This Deed shall confer no authority concerning any other property.

6.11  The Attorney shall not sign any blank instrument, general consent, unrestricted indemnity, waiver of ownership rights or statutory remedies, or undertaking to transfer or surrender land. If any form requires an excluded act, the Attorney shall refrain from signing and refer the matter to the Principals.
duration: 7.1  This authority shall remain in force for twelve months from the date of execution hereof, unless earlier determined by completion of registration of the single Lease Deed and all authorised Schedule C acts, by revocation or by any other event terminating agency under applicable law. The duration of this authority shall not be coextensive with the proposed lease term of twenty nine years and eleven months, and no automatic extension of this authority is granted.

7.2  Each Principal may revoke the authority in respect of his or her own interest, subject to the Indian Contract Act, 1872 and the legal effect of acts already lawfully performed. Notice thereof shall be given to the Attorney, the lessee and the concerned registration and revenue authorities, with such registration or filing as may be required. Termination by death, unsoundness of mind, insolvency or any other statutory event shall be governed by law. Continuance of another Principal's appointment shall not authorise representation of the affected Principal or disposition of the whole parcel without all necessary lawful parties joining.

7.3  The Attorney shall verify only facts within the Attorney's personal knowledge or supported by identified records, expressly disclosing the representative capacity. A declaration, affidavit, proof of being alive or other statement requiring a Principal's personal signature, knowledge or verification shall be made by that Principal personally. No authority to impersonate a deponent or make an untrue statement is conferred.

7.4  The Attorney shall maintain a record of all submissions and furnish every Principal with a copy of each signed document and official acknowledgment within seven days. Original title documents may be produced solely for official inspection and return, against acknowledgment where available, and shall not be deposited with a private party or offered as security.

7.5  The grant of authority in clauses 4 and 5 is exhaustive and shall be construed subject to clause 6. No general or incidental expression shall enlarge the grant. The Principals confirm only acts lawfully performed within the authority expressly conferred by this Deed; no unauthorised act is ratified in advance. This appointment creates no interest in favour of the Attorney and is not intended to constitute an agency coupled with an interest. Mandatory law and lawful third party rights shall remain unaffected.
